subject: Final infra items to close - API keys, org setup, IP + VPC peering
messages:
From: Claire Morgan <claire@wellbridge.health>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@wellbridge.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final infra items to close - quick questions

Diego / Marissa —

Great progress on the eval this month. We're in the final internal review and have two quick asks so we can sign off and schedule the pilot cutover next week:

1) API key provisioning: we need a service account style key with least-privilege for inference calls and a separate key for embedding jobs. Could you confirm the provisioning cadence and whether keys can be rotated by us?

2) Networking: security wants the precise VPC peering setup + the IP allowlist for the hosted endpoints. They're also asking for a small checklist for org-level onboarding (org creation, role bindings, audit log retention).

Can you send the checklist and an estimated timeline for the final step (we hope to go live 12/08)?

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Morgan
Director of Platform Engineering
WellBridge Health

(Attaching our internal PO request in a follow-up)
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Morgan <claire@wellbridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final infra items to close - quick questions

Thanks Claire — quick answers inline and attached a short checklist. See attached 'wellbridge-final-mile-checklist.xlsx'.

1) API keys: We can provision two keys as requested. Standard flow:
  - We create two separate API keys tied to a WellBridge-managed org on our platform: 
    * inference-key-{env} (production/pilot)
    * embedding-key-{env}
  - Keys can be rotated by you via the Console (self-serve) and we support scheduled rotation via our API. I'll include the API call examples in the checklist.

2) Networking: VPC peering is supported for the Dedicated path. For the hosted evaluation (what you ran), we provide IP ranges to allowlist and a short-lived VPC peering option for private routing. Minimal items required for your infra team:
  - CIDR blocks for peering (we will provide per-request).
  - Source IP ranges for hosted endpoints: 34.210.12.0/22, 52.11.160.0/21 (example; final list in the PDF).
  - Service account / IAM role to attach to our peering connection (details in checklist).

Timeline to go live (target 2026-12-08):
  - Today (12/01): Confirm CIDR + who manages route propagation (you vs network team)
  - 12/02: We open the peering request with our infra and provide final peering CIDRs
  - 12/03: Your network performs peering accept + firewall allowlist updates
  - 12/04: Smoke test (end-to-end) with our test key; remediate any issues 12/05
  - 12/08: Pilot cutover (switch keys and promote org)

Looping Naomi (security) to confirm audit-log retention and KMS options, and Karthik for endpoint placement and kernel-sizing during the initial ramp.

Regards,
Diego Fernández
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: wellbridge-final-mile-checklist.xlsx
From: Claire Morgan <claire@wellbridge.health>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@wellbridge.health>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final infra items to close - quick questions

Diego — thanks for the fast reply and the checklist. A couple of clarifications from our infra/security teams:

- We will manage route propagation (so please provide the peer CIDR only).
- For the hosted endpoint IP list, security wants the final authoritative file to import into our firewall (can you send a signed PDF with the ranges and a version/date?)
- Audit logs: we retain logs for 365 days internally. Can you confirm Redwood will export / surface the audit log retention policy and whether we can centralize export to our SIEM via S3?

Also attaching our PO (WellBridge_PO_1226.pdf) and a list of contact points for acceptance testing.

Tom (cc) will be the network owner for the peering work. Tom — are you good with the target 12/08 cutover?

Thanks,
Claire
From: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Morgan <claire@wellbridge.health>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@wellbridge.health>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final infra items to close - quick questions

Claire / Tom —

Short answers: yes, yes, and yes. Details below and attached signed PDF 'vpc-peering-requirements.pdf'.

- Peer CIDR: We'll request 10.41.200.0/22 for the peering connection. Confirm if that collides with your space; if so we can negotiate an alternate.
- Signed IP list: attached PDF includes all public ranges we operate and a timestamped signature block. Use that as the authoritative import for your firewall.
- Audit logs / SIEM: We support S3 export of audit logs and can push daily bundles. Retention policy is configurable up to X years; for the pilot we'll enable 1-year retention for the WellBridge org and set up the S3 export to your ingestion bucket. Naomi — can you confirm the minimal log fields and whether PII redaction is needed for this customer?

Operational next steps (with owners):
  - Tom (WellBridge): confirm peering CIDR by EOD 12/02
  - Karthik (Redwood): create peering request and pre-stage route tables (target 12/02-12/03)
  - Naomi (Redwood): confirm audit-export config and provide S3 ingestion example (12/03)
  - Marissa (Redwood): provision the two service keys once peering is accepted (12/03)
  - Diego: run smoke test with Claire/Tom on 12/04

We will also add a brief rollback play in the checklist (in case we need to revert traffic).

Thanks — Diego
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@wellbridge.health>
To: Diego Fernández <diego@redwood.ai>, Claire Morgan <claire@wellbridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final infra items to close - quick questions

Diego / team —

Confirmed: 10.41.200.0/22 is available and we've approved the peering window. Our network team will accept the peering and update route tables tomorrow morning (12/03).

Claire and I reviewed the signed PDF — good to import into the firewall. Naomi, for SIEM ingestion we prefer S3 with daily gzipped bundles containing JSON events; PII should be redacted at source. Happy to provide a temp bucket and IAM role for ingestion during the pilot.

Marissa: once peering is accepted, please send a test inference key and a test embedding key to the Tom/Claire contact list. We'll run an agreed test script and report results.

If all looks green, we will aim to switch production traffic on 12/08 as planned.

Tom Alvarez
Network Engineering Lead
WellBridge Health

Attachments: WellBridge_PO_1226.pdf
